trigger: Attempting in-process RLIMIT_AS or parent periodic RSS polling for worker memory limits
root_cause: RLIMIT_AS breaks jemalloc 2.3GB virtual arena reservation; parent RSS sampling cannot prevent fast memory spikes or survive parent termination.
verified_remedy: Superseded by kernel cgroup v2 user scope containment in resource_cgroup.py.
limitations: Do not use for production containment; superseded.
